title: Find account IDs that satisfy all of the following: (1) opened in a distric
question: Find account IDs that satisfy all of the following: (1) opened in a district located in 'north Bohemia', (2) have a loan with duration over 24 months approved before 1997, (3) chose monthly statement issuance, and (4) had total transaction amounts exceeding $10,000 in 1997.

arguments.sql:
SELECT a.XCL_001
FROM account a
INNER JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
WHERE d.XCL_019 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
      AND l.XCL_037 > 24
      AND l.XCL_035 < '1997-01-01'
  )
  AND a.XCL_001 IN (
    SELECT t.XCL_047
    FROM trans t
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1997'
    GROUP BY t.XCL_047
    HAVING SUM(t.XCL_051) > 10000
  )

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT a.XCL_001
FROM account a
INNER JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
WHERE d.XCL_019 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
      AND l.XCL_037 > 24
      AND l.XCL_035 < '1997-01-01'
  )
  AND a.XCL_001 IN (
    SELECT t.XCL_047
    FROM trans t
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1997'
    GROUP BY t.XCL_047
    HAVING SUM(t.XCL_051) > 10000
  )

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT a.XCL_001
FROM account a
INNER JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
INNER JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
INNER JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE d.XCL_019 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND l.XCL_037 > 24
  AND l.XCL_035 < '1997-01-01'
  AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1997'
GROUP BY a.XCL_001
HAVING SUM(t.XCL_051) > 10000
